subject.title: fix: active-memory recall fails with billing rejections on subscription-only Claude CLI setups

question: Should subscription-auth embedded dispatch eligibility remain a claude-cli-specific rule in core, or become a provider-owned CliBackendConfig capability consumed by the generic runner?
rationale: Both shapes can fix the observed bug, but the choice defines a new plugin-runtime contract and determines whether future providers extend a generic capability or require additional core allowlist edits.

options.title: Provider capability
options.body: Add a narrow CLI backend capability for subscription-auth embedded dispatch, preserve exact auth-profile selection, and keep core provider-agnostic.

options.title: Core Claude rule
options.body: Keep the claude-cli-only core rule, preserve exact auth-profile selection, and explicitly accept the provider-specific compatibility surface.

recommendation.title: Provider capability
recommendation.body: Add a narrow CLI backend capability for subscription-auth embedded dispatch, preserve exact auth-profile selection, and keep core provider-agnostic.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available feature-history owner for active-memory and can coordinate the plugin-side behavior with the runtime owner.
